title: Payment Idempotency & Risk Hold Ledger Gate
required_invariants: amount_cents <= 0 or blank idempotency_key or currency not in {'USD','EUR','INR'} must raise ValueError.
If idempotency_key is already in seen_keys, return status='duplicate_noop' without charging.
If risk_score >= 80 or amount_cents > 250000, return status='manual_risk_hold'.
Otherwise return status='captured' with deterministic normalized fields.
